derivation: product_b_v5.scope.convex_hull_polygon_wkt over all five unique explicitly georeferenced Hydnora triceps specimen localities in the 2024 taxonomic revision

host_specificity_review.current_revision_statement: The only known host is Euphorbia dregeana; the revision scores this host relationship high confidence from multiple reports and author observations.
host_specificity_review.older_secondary_conflict: A 2021 review listed Zygophyllum orbiculatum as an additional host, but that assignment is not retained for H. triceps in the 2024 specimen- and literature-based revision.
host_specificity_review.execution_rule: Use the 2024 revision's current species/host circumscription; do not reopen host identity after occurrence availability is seen.

interpretation_boundary: This polygon is the no-buffer evidence envelope of explicitly georeferenced specimens in the current revision. It is not asserted to equal the biological range of either host or parasite.
